aiHub.name: Quest for the Fourfold Rings
aiHub.tagline: Steal the light. Bring each other home.
aiHub.description: Two differently gifted heroes steal four rings from stone, crystal, fire and shifting halls while the Ringmaster changes the road. Play with an AI companion, couch co-op, or AI Hub shared-world online co-op, then bind an undying dragon and escape together.
aiHub.controls: Move WASD/left stick; aim mouse/right stick; primary left click/R2; class right click/L2; dodge Space/Cross; context E/Triangle (hold revive/pass); companion Q/R1; objective Tab/Square; pause Esc/Options. Touch assisted sticks/actions. Couch keyboard+pad or two pads; AI Hub online.
